{{Otheruses|Brothers}}
The '''Fungus Brothers''' was the common name for two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] brothers who sold large amounts of [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] at the bazaar in [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]]. They often brought up carts of fungus to sell, including [[glow-fungus]], [[burn-fungus]], and [[Munch-fungus/Legends|munch-fungus]].
